identity.name: Nautilus Chronograph
identity.one_liner: The first Nautilus chronograph since the 5980 was discontinued in 2012, re-released in 18k white gold with an orange-gradient dial — the sport watch collector's 2018 grail.

narrative.story: The 5968G is the first Nautilus chronograph Patek sold with an in-house movement; the 5980/1A-014 (steel, 2014) had used a modified Lemania base. The orange-gradient dial was a deliberate departure from the conservative 5712 palette, and it is the reason the 5968G is the most-photographed modern Patek chronograph. The 5968A (steel, 2023) is the current entry.
